Similarly there is a great need for value addition of soil .
Lemon tanga also has a good market for sorbet pickles etc .
These crops are very much available in Assam but Assamese farmers have not been benefited due to lack of value addition .
A lot of money goes out of the state exchequer to import a lot of seeds to Assam .
But many youth of the state can be established by producing certified seeds of rice mustard soil lemon banana many fruits flowers .
These are in line with the climate in Assam .
But these plants are themselves .
There is room for increasing production and marketing by preserving these medicinal plants by making concerted efforts .
This will benefit the residents of rural Assam .
In addition , many plants produced in Assam are financially profitable by increasing the production of insect fish meat in forests and adding value .
The government has enough to do in this regard .
Implementing government schemes will involve many youth in agricultural trade .
This will solve the unemployment problem in the state as well as economic growth .

The surroundings of Assam fed with tropical and temperate climates .
So Assam is a home of abundance and diversity of plants .
However , as a major result , banana soil sour coconut copper is considered to be a few and it can be said that there is no park on a commercial basis .
The number of unknown secondary fruits in Habibani , the home of Assam , is more than the main fruit .
In a word Assam is a beautiful park of secondary fruits .
A balanced diet is key to the good health of the human body .
One of the main ingredients of this balanced diet is the fruit .
The protein required by the body in the food grain is almost negligible or not the amount of mineral salts in the food .
But these ingredients are abundant in fruits and vegetables .
According to the Health Research Council of India every person should eat 85 grams of fruits daily .
Instead , on an average , we eat only about 46 grams of fruits in all India articles .
But in Assam , many of us do not eat or eat even 1 gram of fruits daily .
As a result our body has become a carrier of various diseases .

The state produces 12.07 lakh tonnes of coconut and copper annually from 103 lakh hectares of land occupied by the fruit .
